issue_context.body:

  - If you need additional help with this template, please refer to https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/

  DO NOT DELETE ANY TEXT from this template! Otherwise, your issue may be closed without comment.
-->
## The problem
<!-- 
  Describe the issue you are experiencing here to communicate to the
  maintainers. Tell us what you were trying to do and what happened.
-->

Samsung TV integration automatically detects Samsung TV as a new integration each time TV is turned on, even after adding the integration.

Choosing "Ignore" has no effect, and it keeps recurring.

## Environment
<!--
  Provide details about the versions you are using, which helps us to reproduce
  and find the issue quicker. Version information is found in the
  Home Assistant frontend: Developer tools -> Info.
-->

- Home Assistant Core release with the issue: 0.109.6
- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): Unknown
- Operating environment (Home Assistant/Supervised/Docker/venv): HassOS/Supervised (Raspberry Pi 4)
- Integration causing this issue: Samsung TV
- Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/samsungtv/

## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml`
<!--
  An example configuration that caused the problem for you. Fill this out even
  if it seems unimportant to you. Please be sure to remove personal information
  like passwords, private URLs and other credentials.
-->

Configured through Integrations panel.

## Traceback/Error logs
<!--
  If you come across any trace or error logs, please provide them.
-->
No relevant logs

## Additional information

Image of recurring detection in integration panel: https://imgur.com/a/dzI62kZ

TV causing the issue is a [KS9000](https://www.samsung.com/au/tvs/suhd-ks9000/UA65KS9000WXXY/).

<sub><sup>(message by IssueLinks)</sup></sub>

```yaml
logger:

  logs:
    homeassistant.components.samsungtv: debug
    homeassistant.components.ssdp: debug
```


That's not quite much. Don't know what to do with this less log.
I will try and get more, but it doesn't happen very reliably, and I can't afford to leave the logger on fulltime as it's on a Pi/SD card.

Managed to capture the initial detection of it.

```
2020-05-18 09:46:49 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.ssdp] Scanning
2020-05-18 09:46:51 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.ssdp] Discovered samsungtv at http://192.168.99.217:7676/rcr/

2020-05-18 09:47:37 DEBUG (SyncWorker_15) [homeassistant.components.samsungtv] Create SamsungTVWS
2020-05-18 09:47:48 DEBUG (SyncWorker_8) [homeassistant.components.samsungtv] Create SamsungTVWS
```

I haven't set my TV as a MAC-based DHCP-assigned IP, so looks like the integration is detecting each different IP as a different integration.

Does the integration not have access to an actual unique identifier (MAC)? If not, that would explain it. If that's the case, might be worth updating docs to mention that it will detect for each different IP.
I'm working on an unique_id other than IP. But this will need some time.
No problems. Glad we got to the bottom of it. I will set my TV to an assigned IP for now to stop the notifications.
I have the same issue. Each time TV turns on I get a discovery notification. No matter how much time I click ignore, the next time I'll get that message again.

> I have the same issue. Each time TV turns on I get a discovery notification. No matter how much time I click ignore, the next time I'll get that message again.

Yes - the solution is to give your TV a fixed IP address, as mentioned. Since doing that, no more discovery.
